issue_detail.value: The artefact gate's conformance and engagement-floor lanes re-read the verdict ledger, the decisions log and each verifier's collection once per unit - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

critic.py brief spends 19 of its 20 seconds walking the artefact corpus, because it reads the files' history without the corpus cache that lane brief opens - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

Shipped guidance tells a consuming project's agent to run the full suite before every commit, which the shipped gate's per-commit selection and push-boundary suite exist to avoid - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

A self-check record reads an author's own edit made in a merge commit as another unit's, so the brief gate admits a changed diff in a project that merges - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

Each meter reading now re-reads every subagent transcript from the start, so a lane, transition or report command takes about 36 s on a long session instead of 22 s - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

critic.py brief's practice and claim-inventory refusals read the whole brief, so the unit diff US1094 embeds can satisfy them, and a unit whose own commit removes a practice gets its brief issued - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

The review brief's unit diff is the whole run's diff over the unit's files, not the unit's own change, so on a shared file the 400-line cap is spent on other units' work and the unit's own hunks are cut - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)
critic.py supersede cannot retire either of two delivery rows that share a unit, date, reviewer and verdict - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)
Re-validate every open project lesson against the current tree, closing those no longer true - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)
backlog_triage's duplicate lens has no way to record a pair confirmed distinct, so a triaged pair is re-reported on every run - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

A commit that adds a subcommand never selects test_cli_grammar.py, which reaches every script through surface.enumerate_scripts, so a grammar defect is first seen by the full suite at push - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)
Six behaviours the self-check record, its brief gate and the author section state are pinned by no test (US1087, US1088, US1089 reviews) - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

Two behaviours BG1000's repair states for per-commit selection are pinned loosely or not at all: the census header's 40-line window, and the rewritten run reason - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

An author self-check record still reads stale in landing orders the per-file own-change view cannot see through: work recorded before its own commit, a cherry-pick, or another unit's hunk in a file the author also changed - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

A review brief now carries two different diffs of the unit: the scope line's `git diff <base> -- <Affects>` (the working tree) and US1094's UNIT DIFF section (base to HEAD) - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)
A seat-requested amendment of an open run's goal leaves the run state on the old goal, so the close's goal read reports 'a different goal' - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

The close's goal panel and the next amendment's carry read only the latest goal-review round, while the plan reads every round on the latest wording, so after an owing seat records alone they disagree on which verdicts stand - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

test_lean_gate_host_docs.py's table test says a hook honouring a value other than 1 fails it, but an edit outside the lines `_hook_code` cuts passes it - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

The builder brief's commit step quotes each Affects path with shlex.quote, but no test has a path with a space, so dropping the quoting stages the wrong paths with every test green - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)
The close checklist's cost row never reads a run holding only its legacy baseline, and its main-thread-only re-derivation note has no test - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)
BG0962's AC7 test proves only the REJECT half of 'the frozen verdict decides' when the per-unit ledger cannot be read - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

Three VELOCITY Priced/pt behaviours US1092 states are pinned by no test: the Source guard, an earlier row keeping its recorded figure, and rows with no Source named in the rate's basis - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

US1095's cost check is pinned only on the older retro shape, cost-baseline add reports a row the median never uses, and its latest-five window has no test - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

critic.py self-check record has no surface for a documentation unit's own prose, so the claims a doc unit makes in the file it changes cannot be recorded under that file - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

A delegated token total supplied for an agent outside this session is dropped whenever the session ran any subagent, because the reading's 'subagents included' flag is per session, not per agent - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

The builder brief tells the builder to write its story file and the self-check log, then commit only its Affects, without saying who commits those two - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)
